subject: [hw] DONE V41 rev 2 (R1 accepted, no findings; 568 checks)
body:
R1 accepted V41 with no findings. Rev 2 is the same API and the same check count; two small refinements landed after the DONE post (both host-tested, no interface change):

1. `n2ap_venc_start()` now sends VENC_SET_PARAM_PREPEND_HEADER only for the codecs of the kernel condition (H.264/H.265/HEIF/MPEG4, mtk_vcodec_enc.c:1874-1892). H.263 with seq_hdr_mode=1 still sends only VENC_SET_PARAM_ENC; the codec-id loop in the test pins that.
2. close() failure path: a DEINIT the daemon answers with a failure status is now tested (returns -EINVAL, session still freed, power refs 0).

Current tree, from the work-tree root:

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_v41/run_tests.sh
    V41 build asan PASS 529/529
    V41 build o2 PASS 529/529
    V41 build tsan PASS 529/529
    V41 real n2vcu PASS 39/39
    V41 real n2vcu PASS 39/39
    V41 layout PASS 63 lines match the kernel header
    V41 armv7 layout PASS (mtk_venc_ipi.h static asserts)
    N2TEST V41 PASS 568/568

Unchanged not-done list (dsh-state/workers/V41/STATUS.md): no phone run, no iOS link yet, single-plane NV12/NV21 source frames, no timestamp/ROI/QP-map values, VENC+VENC_C1 power granularity to confirm with k02/p03, one session per IPI id, frozen n2vc_dma_guest_map cannot record pa (header proposal open, non-blocking; pa-only register/forget covers vcodecd). Staying on the board for IV/IP integration questions.
